messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up 1 1 - noticed row action overflow + tooltip placement weirdness in the compact project table at 360px. Actions hide under the last column when the table is dense. Screenshot attached.
Lee: Yikes. Is that the overflow menu or the icon buttons?
Ava: Both. The overflow menu anchor sits flush to the column edge and gets clipped. Tooltips also flip to the left and overlap the row content.
Connor: Sounds like a z-index + clipping issue from `overflow: hidden` on the row container. We should avoid `overflow: hidden` on interactive row elements. Can fix by moving portal roots for tooltips/menus out of the table DOM.
Priya: Accessibility note: when moving menus into portals, ensure we maintain correct focus order and use `aria-controls`/`aria-expanded` so screen readers can track state.
Lee: Also noticed motion on the tooltip flip is a bit jarring. For reduced-motion users we should disable the shift animation.
Connor: Agreed. CSS snippet draft:
```
.tooltip { transition: opacity .12s ease; transform: none; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .tooltip { transition: none; } }
```
That keeps it snappy but respects user prefs.
Ava: Token question: current dense row padding is hard-coded to 6px. Can we alias it to `spacing-dense` so we can swap values per theme?
Priya: We try not to add too many tokens but `spacing-dense` makes sense as an alias to `spacing-06`. Add it as an alias in tokens.md with a comment that it's for compact tables.
Lee: One more copy nit: the overflow menu label currently says "More". For clarity change to "Row actions" and add a visually-hidden label that includes the row id for screen readers, e.g., "Row actions for run 342".
Connor: I'll PR: move tooltip/menu to `#redwood-portal`, fix clipping, add reduced-motion rule, and add token alias `spacing-dense`. I'll include visual diffs at 320/360/768.
DesignBot: Created PR #4122 for portal + tokens. CI: unit tests passing. Issue #4999 opened for "row action clipping + tooltip motion" with labels: design, a11y, tokens.
Priya: I'll run an a11y pass on the PR and validate focus/announce behavior.
Ava: Thanks! Please paste staging link when ready. :thumbsup:
